'''Kurg's Focus''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Taskmaster Kurg]], a [[boss]] in [[Vloxen Excavations]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[Illusion Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge of [[Illusion Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Jeweled Chakram]] from collectors [[Arliss Vaughn]], [[Bariel Darkroot]], or [[Dauv Merishahl]] or crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Illusion Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Jeweled Chakram]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Aptitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
The [[Illusion Magic]] version of [[Droknar's Focus]] has stats identical to this item.
